description: This source file defines a class 'MemoryPoolBlock' used for managing memory blocks within a slab in a memory pool, including creation, disposal, and referencing to underlying slabs and pools. It is part of the Orleans networking shared library, specifically related to memory management.

classes.name: MemoryPoolBlock
classes.description: A block tracking object used by the byte buffer memory pool, representing a subdivided memory slab with references to its pool and slab, and supporting disposal via 'Dispose' method.

methods.name: MemoryPoolBlock
methods.description: Constructor initializing a memory block with references to the pool and slab, offset, and length, creating a memory view from the slab's array.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases the memory block back to the pool.
